_notes: Granite Backcountry Alliance glade zones in western Maine (operator tag in OSM: Granite Backcountry Alliance).
Geometry from OpenStreetMap (ODbL); run build_backcountry.py after editing. Mostly moderate tree skiing, not big avalanche terrain,
but no avalanche center forecasts these areas, so they are 'no avalanche forecast — conditions score only'. Not a recommendation to ski.

zone.name: GBA Glades (Maine)
zone.no_forecast_note: No avalanche center forecasts these glades. Check Granite Backcountry Alliance's zone rules and parking/land-access notes before going.

area_hazards.Burnt Meadow: Hand-cut glades: stumps, rocks and tree wells, thin cover early season. Respect the landowner rules GBA posts for the zone.
area_hazards.Whitecap (Rumford): Hand-cut glades: stumps, rocks and tree wells, thin cover early season. Respect the landowner rules GBA posts for the zone.
